# First-run pane fixtures

`trust`, `keyApproval`, `resume` and `fullscreen` mirror the simulated tmux
output in `packages/base/test/boot-agents.test.sh`. The remaining cases are
synthetic, with no real paths, identities, URLs or credentials. No CLI version
or real capture provenance is known; confirm the patterns before merging.
JSON escapes keep the files ASCII while testing the rendered glyphs.
